description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commit and tag message handling, specifically for messages that contain CRLF line endings. It defines functions to create references with CRLF messages, tests to verify that Git commands correctly process these messages, and sets up various test cases for branches, tags, logs, and shows.

methods.name: create_crlf_ref
methods.description: Creates a git reference with a commit and tag message that contain CRLF line endings, extracts subject and body content, and tags the branch.

methods.name: create_crlf_refs
methods.description: Sets up multiple references with CRLF messages for testing various scenarios.

methods.name: test_crlf_subject_body_and_contents
methods.description: Runs tests to verify that Git commands correctly handle commit and tag messages with CRLF endings, checking formats like --format, --list, --oneline, --grep, etc.
